visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a white T-shirt, jumps and screams with extreme physical energy in a well-lit indoor living room. She holds a Nintendo Switch with neon red and blue Joy-Cons. A large green indoor plant and a television are visible in the background. (2) The girl spins around holding the console with a wide-open mouth, then the scene cuts to her wearing a pink 'Princess' birthday crown while hugging the Nintendo Switch box tightly against her chest. She looks directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, joyful expression. (3) The scene transitions to the same girl several years older, now a teenager with long hair, wearing a white polo shirt with a red collar. She is in the same living room environment, spinning around while holding a red Nintendo Switch OLED box, expressing similar excitement through facial gestures. (4) The teenage girl stands still and holds a black Nintendo Switch console horizontally in front of her face, partially obscuring her eyes and nose. The background shows a wooden-paneled wall and a TV screen.

Female vocals are heard singing 'Happy Birthday to You' in Korean with a cheerful, melodic intonation. (2) The non-verbal cheering continues at a high intensity, blending with the rhythmic pulse of the background music. The BPM is fast and consistent. Very faint, low-bandwidth thudding sounds suggest movement or jumping on a tiled surface. (3) The music maintains its energetic major-key tonality as the visual transitions. The high-pitched vocalizations remain constant in volume and valence, indicating a sustained state of celebration. No distinct sound of objects or speech is heard over the dominant music track.
